scope: Exact turbine-table graphs on synthetic cases and the documented operating Tokke–Vinje subset. Fixed commitment restricts proof scope.
method: Sequential fresh models within each campaign; equal allowances. Warmups and local probes excluded; construction, native solve, reconstruction and replay included in total_seconds. Hosted runs are silent, use common fully audited starts, and warm both modes.
source_hash_method: SHA256 of concatenated sorted src/*.jl contents
notes: Compare variants within each campaign; different machines can prepare different common seeds. Initial local two-hour trials trace each node and warm only free commitment. Local PCHIP native starts are rejected equally; see per-row note. Later local watercourse trials crossed verified sleep and are excluded. External inputs and generated schedules are not redistributed.
